item.title: Community Update - October
item.description:
Hello Space Marines,

It’s time for our monthly Community Update! We’re keeping things a little lighter this time around, as the team is fully focused on cooking up new content for Patch 16 and beyond. Don’t worry, we’ll have plenty to show you soon!

Now, let’s discuss the most recent topics around Space Marine 2, as well as our latest milestone and the upcoming community events!

RECENT TOPICS

Reddit Q&A with Game Director

Recently, we hosted a Q&A on Reddit, and got many entries. Game Director Dmitry Grigorenko answered a bunch of questions from you. The entire retranscription is here! Read it now 😊

Hotfixes 15.1 / 15.2

This month, we deployed the Hotfix 15.1 and Hotfix 15.2 to address key issues and improve overall gameplay balance.

Here’s a quick summary of some of the changes brought to the game:

One-Handed Thunder Hammer & Power Maul: Buffed overall damage, sped up charge time, and improved movesets.

Melta Rifles: Improved damage range fall off and increased base ammo/magazine capacity.

Game modes: Various balance changes and bug fixes in Chaos Siege, and resolved multiple bugs in Crucible.

QoL & Fixes: Added brief invulnerability after knockback, fixed item spawns out of bounds, and resolved cloth/robe customization color bugs.

Twitch Drops

We’ve taken good note of your discontent surrounding our last Drops campaign, where the Victrix Honour Guard Storm Shield was available through Twitch’s “Support A Streamer” feature and required a purchase. We will make this shield available in the Refinement & Redemption shop with the launch of Patch 17. It’ll be unlockable with Requisition Points, as this was the case for our previous Drops.

PATCH 16

Patch 16 will bring no less than 6 new Heroic Weapons. Let’s unveil them:

  • Omnissian Axe: holding the attack generates and maintains a big shock zone.

  • Heavy Bolt Pistol: fire rate is increased when shooting without aiming, and the damage is greatly increased in close range.

  • Bolt Rifle: rhythmic firing of single shots gradually increases damage.

  • Las Fusil: doesn’t need to be charged and slowly regenerates ammo.

  • Plasma Incinerator: damage is increased when overheating.

  • Infernus Heavy Bolter: has an underbarrel flamethrower.

Also, here’s a first teaser for the upcoming Mortifactors Cosmetic Pack:

15 MILLION PLAYERS

This month we’re celebrating another amazing milestone, which makes us very proud: Space Marine 2 has reached 15 Million Players! 🎊🍾

Fifteen million is a number we didn’t even imagine reaching when we released the game two years ago. We know very well that the community plays the most part in spreading love for the game to new players. So, on behalf of Saber and Focus; we truly thank every single one of you. And to the newest Space Marines among you, welcome! Glory to you and the Emperor! 💙

YEAR 3 PASS - SCREENSHOT CONTEST

To celebrate Halloween, and the best season of the year returning, we’re hosting a contest! This time, let us see the spookiest screenshots/virtual photos you have taken in Space Marine 2. 🎃🦇

  • Two winners will be picked on November 2nd. Both of them will receive a Year 3 Pass key for Steam. 

  • Submit your entry either on Discord or on X!

📅 You have until November 1st to participate. Good luck 👻

COMMUNITY EVENT 

A Community Event is still live right now until November 03!

Hold the line and survive a total of 15 waves in Chaos Siege Mode to earn 100 Accolades. These 15 waves may be completed through several sessions combined, and each completed one will count regardless of your difficulty setting. Join the battle now!

FOCUS TOGETHER COMMUNITY IDEAS

This month, we took a deep dive into your ideas on Focus Together to get your feedback on various features and gameplay elements. Here are some of the most popular community ideas, along with responses directly from our Game Director, Dmitry Grigorenko:

1. Account-wide progression in Crucible Mode

💡{LINK REMOVED}Community ​idea: Make Crucible progression account-wide rather than character-bound to reduce the grind and allow more freedom to switch classes. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: It’s been only a few days since the latest hotfix that fixed various manipulations with difficulty of the mode and we want to give players a bit more time and gather more data before making any harsh decisions, like suggested. We do want to keep the progression per class, but the speed of the progression and balance of specific penances will be adjusted if necessary once we have more data. We just need more time to analyse it.

2. Mandatory team perks

💡{LINK REMOVED}Community ​idea: Restrict access to Absolute difficulty so that players must have a Team Perk equipped. This prevents under-leveled or under-prepared players from joining top-tier missions and improves mission success rates.

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: We are planning to implement a level lock to end game activities like Hard Stratagems and Hard Siege. Team perk restriction seems very specific and currently not planned.

3. Blood Angels Champion customization

💡Community Idea: Update and expand customization options for the Blood Angels Champion cosmetic parts to better match Chapter lore and armor sets.

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: I don’t want to spoil things and say yes or no to this. Lets just say there will be some major improvements in this area further down the line.

4. Omni-Scrambler for the Tactical

💡Community Idea: Add the Omni-Scrambler wargear to the Tactical class to offer more customization options. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: Omni-Scrambler is a very specific device in the lore that is not available for Intercessors. However, actual Deathwatch backpacks and devices are currently in plans for Tactical.

5. MK VI Greave Emblems

 

💡Community Idea: Allow emblems/decals to be placed on the upper area of the Mk VI "Corvus" greaves so players can apply appropriate Chapter, squad, and campaign markings. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: Yes this is currently planned.

6. Backpack Emblem customization

💡Community Idea: Allow players to apply emblems and decals to power backpacks, similar to the existing options for knee markings.

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: This is something that has been sitting in our backlog for a while. We will come back to it once we finish with already planned customization improvements, since those will be more impactful.

7. Starting equipment selection

💡Community Idea: Allow players to select their starting equipment/grenades in loadouts to better support specific class builds and playstyles. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: We would like to keep the exploration and randomness aspect of PvE. With the abundance of equipment restoration perks this would mean that everyone would just pick a melta bomb.

8. Sniper hood customization 

💡Community Idea: Add more hooded head options for the Sniper class and allow hoods to be recolored to better fit different Chapter color schemes. 

💬 Dmitry Grigorenko: Yes this is currently in the works right now.

That’s it for this month!

As always, we want to thank you for the unwavering support, and we remain attentive to your feedback with every update. 

Don’t forget you can follow Focus on all our socials (Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X and Bluesky) and join the community on Discord now!

See you next month, Space Marines.

The Emperor Protects 🪽

The Saber & Focus teams

item.title: Special Live Event: Arcane Ruin + Hotfix 1.13.4
item.description:
Admonition scholars have uncovered an ancient ritual buried deep within their foul, heretic tomes. Using these fell rites, they have bound a powerful daemon into a Daemonhost. Agents report that this new horror seems to appear when others of its kin are slain.

Emboldened by the dreaded Daemonhost Gormaggoth’s presence, the streets are plagued with lesser Daemonhosts. Seek them out and destroy them.

Starting today until November 5, participate in the event by playing missions with the ‘Hunted’ condition, and destroy the Daemonhosts.

Beware, the Daemonhost Gormaggoth has an ever-increasing chance of appearing for every one of its kin you slay. Uncover more about the origin of these heretical abominations as you battle this terrible foe.

This event has two forms of progression! 

  • Killing Daemonhosts in missions with the ‘Hunted’ condition will progress your personal event tracker, which rewards you with Dockets, Diamantine, Plasteel, and this brand new Weapon Charm:

  • Dealing damage to the dreaded Daemonhost Gormaggoth will advance a community event tracker, which every player contributes to! This rewards the entire playerbase with Dockets, Diamantine and Plasteel, as well as unlocking new lore short stories (written by Dan Abnett!) with each step.

    • If the community racks up enough damage, the Daemonhost Gormaggoth will be slain for good, unlocking this brand new Portrait frame:

Hotfix 1.13.4 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below!

This hotfix contains a handful of important fixes, including reducing the Vanguards’ health and fixing some crashes.

Patch 1.13.4 patch notes
General Fixes

  • Scab Vanguard & Dreg Vanguard: reduced their health back to their correct, intended values.

  • Fixed crash affecting players on AMD RX 7000 series GPUs. As a workaround, FSR 4.1.1 has been disabled for RDNA3 GPUs on Windows 10.

  • Fixed startup crash on Intel Arc GPUs linked to the XeSS module.

  • Fixed a crash that could occur when tracking any of the removed "The Depths Purge the Unclean" Penances

  • Fixed the launcher so that it doesn't create a crash dump file on shutdown.

  • Fixed an issue where the launcher could block players from starting the game.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed some clipping with Drill Fatigues (Cadian 43rd, Broken Swords, XXXXL)

Known Issues

  • Scab and Dreg Vanguard enemies currently have slightly more health than intended.

    • Fixed!

We’ve also got some comments on a few of the changes we’ve done in the last few updates:

  • Corruption Damage Change

    • In the previous Hotfix (1.13.3) we changed how Corruption Damage is dealt. Previously, corruption damage alone couldn't outright kill you. This was only ever intended for Grimoire damage, and so we 'fixed' it for other damage sources. However, we understand that this is being relied upon by many as a feature, and so we'll keep an extra close eye on this.

  • Servo-Skull Damage Nerf

    • In the Depths of the Damned Update (1.13.0) the Servo-Skull had its Strength reduced from 160 to 100. This was an internal change that was meant to go live with the release of Skitarii in 1.12.0, meaning this was the original intended power level of the Servo-Skull, which instead went live on 1.13.0.

    • This brings us to today. Although the Servo-Skull now has the initially intended Strength, we are re-evaluating if the nerf was justified and are considering further balance adjustments to both it and the Noospheric Command Talent.

That’s all for today!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team

item.title: Hotfix 15.2
item.description:
HOTFIX 15.2

GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING TWEAKS

Melee in PvE

One-Handed Thunder Hammer

Gameplay

  • Accumulation stance can be entered even if the hammer already has charges. If the hammer has maximum charges the Charged Impact attack will be triggered.

  • Time for getting 1 charge is decreased to 1.25 seconds.

  • Energy Loop now can be performed after Charged Impact. Energy loop damage is increased by 100%.

  • Underhand Swing damage is increased by 30%.

  • Charged Impact damage is increased by 15%.

Weapon Perks

  • “Preparedness” and “Brutal Reforge” perks now trigger when an enemy was killed with a Finisher by a One Handed Hammer.

  • “Preparedness” perk ability restoration is increased to 5%.

  • “Perfect Reprisal” ability damage bonus is increased to 50%. Fixed an issue that applied the bonus damage to any melee attack instead of just Light Attacks.

Heroic One-Handed Thunder Hammer - Power Maul

  • Heroic perk no longer deals increased damage based on the number of charges.

  • Charged Impact now can be performed with 1-2 charges.

  • Ground Slam now can be performed with 3 charges.

  • Ground Slam now forces stagger enemies.

  • Ground Slam damage is increased by 30% and attack radius is increased by 100%.

Please note that the text descriptions for the Power Maul have not been updated to reflect these changes, they will be updated in a future patch.

CRUCIBLE

  • Fixed an issue where the Guardian Relic was disabled for the entire team when only one player activated the Curse of the Warp Penance.

  • Fixed an issue where Stratagems allowed players to select a mission and difficulty for Crucible through the Hub Terminal.

  • Fixed an issue where PvE Quick Match players could be matched into Crucible.

GENERAL FIXES

  • Tactical: Fixed a bug where the Bolt Rifle used in the secondary slot would deal less damage than in the primary slot when using the “Tactical Reserve” perk.

  • Tactical: Fixed a bug with the Plasma Pistol having the buff from "Versatility" even if no Primary Weapon was equipped.

  • Chaos Siege: Fixed a spawn issue where enemy Loyalist Marine could spawn behind the closed gates in some cases.

  • Siege: Fixed a bug with Techmarine’s Weighty Attack class challenge not progressing with One Handed Thunder Hammer charged kills.

  • Siege: Fixed a  softlock where Space Marines could get stuck in the transition zone after a wave sequence.

  • Crash fixes and general stability improvements.

  • Lots of minor UI and localisation fixes.
